signal: Incredible Health debuted two AI agents, Gale and Lyn, in late 2025, expanding its healthcare hiring marketplace used by 1,500+ hospital locations.

email.subject1: a signal play for Incredible Health
email.body1:
Jennifer, saw Incredible Health debuted Gale and Lyn across the hiring marketplace.

Expanding the product usually opens more in-market health systems than the team can cover before quota catches up, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Incredible Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jennifer, quick follow-up for Incredible Health.

As the product expands, the number climbs faster than headcount can. Most CROs don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Incredible Health needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jennifer, last bit of proof for Incredible Health.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Incredible Health's reply rate likely compares to other healthtech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jennifer, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Mid product expansion, I know the GTM stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your health-system motion? I'll tailor it to Incredible Health either way.
